negative_evidence.evidence: The raw canary is absent from first-run and reconstructed-agent log buffers.
The raw canary is absent from two classified request payloads and both authenticated server responses.
Exactly two durable report_json rows are read through a real pgx pool after Sync; neither contains the canary.
A reconstructed server reads the durable report through the authenticated Admin API; both its JSON and the real operator CLI rendering omit the canary. The CLI fixture tree is also scanned.
Agent state and journal inputs contain the canary; every decompressed diagnostic entry validates as classified metadata and omits the raw value.

The raw Postgres envelope_json and the restored encrypted-record inventory omit the canary, restored external-KEK coverage is complete, and the canary is recovered only at the trusted resolver boundary before its material buffer is cleared.

The armed endpoint transaction tree contains no plaintext before or after restart recovery; the trusted recovery callback receives the canary exactly once, terminal reconstruction does not replay it, and the protected tree is rescanned after cleanup.
Public secret deletion leaves zero secret_versions rows and endpoint deletion cascades to zero drift_reports rows.

supporting_regressions.scope: clean disposable Compose stack and complete test/e2e suite

environment_reconciliation.diagnosis: The database had been rebuilt while root-owned agent state retained endpoint identities from an older stack, producing 403 unknown endpoint responses in pre-existing tests.
environment_reconciliation.resolution: The repository-owned make test-e2e target removed volumes and endpoint state together, rebuilt the disposable stack, and passed the complete suite.
